notes.title: Ladies I’m Ready v1.1.31125 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Hello, fellow student of UOH, we hope you are enjoying your first week of “school”![/b]

Today, we are bringing the first campus maintenance to improve your life on campus!

[b]“Roadblocks Removed”[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed “Legendary Trophy” achievement couldn’t be unlocked (after updating, simply play a scene, and the achievement should be unlocked if you have all the rest unlocked)
[*] Fixed achievements not synced on Steam and in-game if in-game achievement was already unlocked prior
[*] Fixed some typos
[/list]

[b]“Campus Life Improvements”[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now skip texting if you have already texted before
[/list]

That’s it for now! Thanks for choosing UOH. If you want to stay up to date with the latest events and news, please join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/pEQreFcUa5]Discord[/url][/b]!

Make sure to follow Midou Studio on [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@Midou_Studio]Youtube[/url][/b], [b][url=https://x.com/Midou_studio]X[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/midou.studio/]Instagram[/url][/b] as well!

notes.title: Ladies I'm Ready Launch Times!
notes.content:
With the launch of Ladies I'm Ready only one day away, we are back with another post with more important details for you to unpack! Today, we’re sharing information about some important dates for your diary!

The game will launch at the same time for all players across the world, so take note of when that is in your local timezone, add it to your wishlist and prepare to enjoy an out-of-this-world adventure with Samuel while he decides whether it's JESS or BRITTANY in Midou Studio's latest FMV!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45406021/aa8c455a93de9f5ee5654bb49de1ef4a068b1078.png[/img]


[h3][b]When does Ladies I'm Ready launch in your local timezone[/b][/h3]
Los Angeles ---7 March 18:00 PST
Toronto --------7 March 21:00 EST
Mexico City ----7 March 20:00 CST
Brasilia ---------7 March 23:00 BRT
New York ------7 March 21:00 EST
London --------8 March 2:00 GMT
Madrid ---------8 March 3:00 CET
Johannesburg - 8 March 4:00 SAST
Nairobi ---------8 March 5:00 EAT
Beijing ---------8 March 10:00 CST
Seoul ----------8 March 11:00 KST
Tokyo ----------8 March 11:00 JST
Sydney --------8 March 13:00 AEDT


If you want to stay up to the latest news about the game, we recommend joining our [url=https://discord.gg/pEQreFcUa5]Discord[/url] to stay up to date and to discuss all things related to Ladies I'm Ready!

Make sure to follow Midou Studio on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Midou_Studio]Youtube[/url], [url=https://x.com/Midou_studio]X[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/midou.studio/]Instagram[/url] as well!

See everyone tomorrow at UOH! (the school Samuel goes to)
